questions.question: A is older than B and C is younger than D. D is younger than A and B is younger than C. Arrange them in descending order of their ages.
questions.solution:
From the statements:

A is older than B and C is younger than D → A > B, D > C

D is younger than A and B is younger than C → A > D, C > B

On combining both the statements, we get: A > D > C > B

Hence, A > D > C > B is correct.

questions.question:
Read the following information and answer the question that follows.

 
• K + M means 'K is the daughter of M'
 
• K - M means 'K is the husband of M'
 
• K × M means 'K is the brother of M'

If T × V + Z, which of the following is true?

options.text: T is the father of Z.
T is the son of Z.
T is the brother of Z.
T is the uncle of Z.

questions.solution:
Given: 

K + M means 'K is the daughter of M'.

K - M means 'K is the husband of M'.

K × M means 'K is the brother of M'.

Coded relation: T × V + Z

Now draw a family tree using the following notations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

The relation diagram for the above relation is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74190938c266f96523eaecec0fe0d00a5b3df817cb48d6fa4c49583f32bd3969.png] 

Let us consider each option statement.

1. T is the father of Z → False (T is the son of Z)

2. T is the son of Z → True 

3. T is the brother of Z → False (T is the son of Z)

4. T is the uncle of Z → False (T is the son of Z)

Hence, **'T is the son of Z' **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

 
• No stick is bun.
 
• All buns are balls.

**Conclusions:**

I. No stick is ball.

II. No ball is a stick.

III. Some ball are buns.

IV. All the balls are buns.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follows

questions.solution:
The possible venn diagram for the above statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91d77871348c6682a7ff43644e5dd470a02bfa2512d0a2212472f8c2b7ce6ada.png] 

For conclusions:

I. No stick is ball → False (No stick is ball is a possibility but not definite)

II. No ball is a stick → False (No ball is a stick is a possibility but not definite)

III. Some ball are buns → True (All buns are balls is given. Therefore, some balls are definitely buns)

IV. All the balls are buns → False (All balls are buns is a possibility but not definite)

Hence, **Only conclusion III follows** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Aarti was born three years after her mother's marriage. Her father is 6 years younger than her mother but 19 years older than Aarti, who is 6 years old. At what age did the mother get married?
questions.solution:
Age of Aarti = 6 years

Age of Aarti's father = 6 years + 19 years = 25 years

Age of Aarti's mother = 25 years + 6 years = 31 years

Age, at which the mother got married = 31 years - 6 years - 3 years

31 years - 9 years = 22 years.

Hence, **22 ****years **is correct.

questions.question: If all the numbers from 1 to 150 are written down, then how many times do we write 6?
questions.solution:
From numbers 1 to 150, we have:

Numbers having unit digit as 6 = 15 times

(06, 16, 26, 36, 46, 56, 6**6**, 76, 86, 96, 106, 116, 126, 136, 146)

Numbers having unit tens digit as 6 = 10 times

(60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 65, **6**6, 67, 68, 69)

Total number of times, we write 6 = 15 + 10 = 25 times

Hence, **25 **is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**66 is being counted twice here, as there are two 6's in 66.

The words are written below in the order of dictionary:

2. **ind**ulgent
